verses.verse:
संसारस्थित जीवानाम् व्यवहाराय परस्परम्।
कल्पिता ब्रम्हणा ह्येते भावाभिव्याक्ति हेतवः।११३।
verses.text: For the dealings of beings living in the world with one another, these were devised by Brahmā as the means of expressing bhāva (feeling).

commentary.text: That is, so that the beings in the world can deal with one another, Brahmā himself, through the Sāma Veda, created ālāpa and the like relating to music.
